bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON... Combined seas 9 to 10 ft this evening, increasing to 10 to 12 ft late Tuesday. Bar conditions rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 415 PM Monday, 445 AM and 445 PM Tuesday. The afternoon ebbs on Monday and Tuesday will be strong.
